headline: Shaheen Shah Afridi took 4-46 as Pakistan bowled England out for 241 in 46.4 overs in the tri-series ODI in Lahore, despite Ben Duckett's 105 off 111 balls.

card.desc: Duckett hits 105; Pakistan need 242 to win in Lahore.

caption:
Captain Shaheen Shah Afridi took 4-46 as Pakistan bowled England out for 241 in 46.4 overs in the tri-series ODI in Lahore, Arab News reports. Ben Duckett made 105 off 111 balls and added 93 with Sam Curran, while debutant Razaullah took 2-38, Dawn adds.
